summary: Bug fix in Pocket Shape's open-path handling: processVerticalFaces now builds the helper closing edge when the open wire has one end face (slice the face for its two endpoints) as well as two, and re-adds removed faces to the candidate compound, replacing Python errors with the already-documented Close Open Path behaviour; no property, default, enumeration, task-panel, or output change.

meta.title: CAM: PocketShape - Open path fix for one and two faces
